summary.headline: Planetary Apogees and Perigees
summary.text: Discussion of planetary apogees and perigees, comparing positions in the Khaqani Zij for Malikshahi year 400 with updated positions from Ulugh Beg’s Zij for year 518. It explains Mercury’s deferent, true, and orbital apogees and perigees, with degrees, minutes, and seconds for the Sun, Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Venus, and Mercury.
